models.name: GR00T
models.protocol: Native InvertedPendulum-v4; state 4, RGB224, five discrete forces, H1; env/obs 5/5 FPS; L0 simulated zero latency, B/F RTX 3090 measured-only latency, 20 episodes each, seeds 42–61, cap 1000; hold/FIFO, one worker; B/F prompt 0/1. P: 5×10 episodes, cap 900,800 canonical samples. Teacher E10: simulated IID, seeds 104771–104780, repeated selection seeds.
models.training: Fresh L0/profile QwenGR00T, Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct + DiT-B, 2000 updates each, seed 42, global 64, 4 inference timesteps / 8 diffusion repeats, LR VLM/head 1e-5/1e-4, warmup 100. Profile APPO seed 0, target 1M / actual 1,007,616 steps; Final step 1968 selected on tied final/best 20.
models.data: Shared L0 APPO H1 data, 100 episodes, 90/10 split, 90,000/10,000 rows; only clock/prompt metadata changed25→5 FPS. Profile probe12/12; 100 accepted/100 attempts (ceiling120), strict return>900, 90/10 episodes, 90,000/10,000 rows; train-only min-max once.
limitations: One training run per model; episode population SD is not uncertainty across training seeds. Different clocks, training recipes and measured latency distributions preclude controlled architecture ranking or equal-delay causal claims.
Teacher E10 repeats the first ten selection seeds (104771–104780); it is not independent validation.
No independent formal evaluation of the shared historical L0 APPO teacher is available; accepted demonstration returns are not substituted. Historical source clock was 25/25 FPS.
